-- RESUMO FINAL: clientes que veem "sem cotas" por estarem inativos mas terem cotas cadastradas
-- E que já fizeram login no sistema (confirmando que estão tentando acessar)
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.name,
  ac.email AS email_cadastrado,
  ac.is_active,
  COUNT(cq.id) AS cotas_ativas,
  u.lastSignedIn AS ultimo_login,
  CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIM' ELSE 'NÃO' END AS tem_login
FROM allowed_clients ac
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
LEFT JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
WHERE ac.is_active = 0
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.name, ac.email, ac.is_active, u.lastSignedIn, u.id
HAVING cotas_ativas > 0
ORDER BY ultimo_login DESC;
